messages:
celeste: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 12. We need a compact, executable guardrail spec for rollouts: containment, auto-actions, owners, and a simple recurrence fingerprint so analytics can catch repeats.

yang: Yes. keep it small so PMs and SREs can read it. propose two paths: auto-quarantine+fallback, or immediate auto-rollback if signature is severe.

tomo: Define signature exactly. My vote: any combo of (error_rate > 4x baseline in 5m) OR (p99_latency > 2.5x baseline) OR (quality_drop >= 3% on probe-set). If two of three hit, immediate rollback.

grant: Also want a hard blast-radius cap per-flag: max_sample_pct (e.g., 10%) and an emergency cap (e.g., 1%) that runtime enforces even if config says higher.

celeste: Agreed. Draft gating snippet (JSON) we can store as `gating_config_id` and reference from deployments: 

```
{
  "gating_config_id":"g-2026-02-01-01",
  "flag":"ai-reply-v2",
  "phases":["0.5%","5%","25%","100%"],
  "max_sample_pct":"10%",
  "emergency_cap_pct":"1%",
  "phase_timeout_minutes":60,
  "containment_window_minutes":10,
  "signatures":{
    "error_spike":{"multiplier":4.0,"window_mins":5},
    "latency_tail":{"p99_multiplier":2.5,"window_mins":5},
    "quality_probe":{"eval_set":"probe_v2","drop_pct":3.0}
  },
  "auto_actions":["quarantine","fallback_pin","rollback"],
  "fingerprint_fields":["flag","model_variant","signature_id"]
}
```

yang: Nice. runtime behaviors: on 'quarantine' we pin 95% traffic to previous stable variant and route 5% to canary with doubled sampling of probe prompts. 'fallback_pin' holds for containment_window_minutes and auto-rollback if signature persists.

tomo: Telemetry we need: counters `guardrail.quarantine`, `guardrail.fallback_pin`, `guardrail.rollback`, gauge `guardrail.time_in_quarantine`, and event `guardrail.fingerprint` with the fingerprint string. analytics can group by fingerprint to detect recurrence.

grant: Ownership & deadlines: 
 - celeste: write RFC + canonical gating examples (due 4 business days)
 - yang: implement runtime enforcement of emergency_cap + fallback_pin (due 2 weeks)
 - tomo: probe-set + eval integration + baseline snapshots (due 1 week)
 - grant: recurrence dashboard + 30/90-day report + calendar invite automation (due 3 weeks)

deploy-bot: NOTE: PRs touching rollout defaults must include `./ci/guardrail_smoke.sh` and pass `smoke-rollout` job. Deploys referencing gating_config_id must attach a `deployment.audit` event.

celeste: Also add a small human-in-the-loop flag: `hold_until_approval` that prevents promotion to the next phase until an approver clicks approve in console. Use for high-risk models.

yang: One more pattern detection item: store rolling windows of signatures per-flag for 90 days and run a weekly job that emails owners if a fingerprint appears > once. This should be the default recurrence alert.

tomo: For gradations: if a fingerprint recurs but never reached rollback, consider raising the severity after 2 occurrences and force a manual review.

grant: I'll prototype the fingerprint as `sha1(flag + variant + signature_id)` and include it in the event payload. analytics can decode which fields composed it.

celeste: Action: I'll file the RFC and create the tickets with the owner assignments above. If no objections I'll set due dates.

yang: ACK. starting runtime branch tomorrow. :thumbsup:

tomo: ACK. will prepare probe_v2 and the snapshot tooling.

grant: ACK. will sketch dashboard mockups this week.

deploy-bot: REMINDER: all guardrail PRs must include `smoke-rollout` success and a brief ops-runbook blurb. Merge blocked otherwise.

celeste: Thanks all 10. I'll post links to RFC + tickets when ready.
